name: 75health
one_liner: Cloud-based EHR built on open-source OpenEMR platform
short_description: 75Health is a cloud-based electronic health records system built on the open-source OpenEMR platform. Offers charting, scheduling, and basic practice management features for small medical practices...
long_description:
75Health is a cloud-based EHR solution that leverages the open-source OpenEMR platform to provide electronic health records functionality. The system offers clinical charting, appointment scheduling, patient demographics management, and basic billing features.

As an OpenEMR-based solution, 75Health benefits from a large open-source community while providing hosted cloud infrastructure so practices don't need to manage their own servers. The platform is designed for small to mid-sized medical practices seeking affordable EHR capabilities.

75Health serves general medical practices including primary care, specialty clinics, and some behavioral health settings. The system provides standard EHR features without the complexity or cost of enterprise-focused platforms.

While functional for basic clinical documentation, 75Health lacks the mental health-specific features, therapy note templates, and behavioral health workflows found in purpose-built psychiatric EHR systems.
best_for: Small medical practices seeking affordable cloud EHR
Practices with basic charting and scheduling needs
not_for: Mental health practices needing therapy-specific templates
Organizations requiring advanced reporting and analytics
